reason: Examined dependency IDs: def-riemannian-isometry-and-local-isometry, thm-hopf-rinow, def-covering-map-and-evenly-covered-neighbourhoods, lem-local-isometries-send-geodesics-to-geodesics, def-countable-choice. Strategy: Lift radial geodesics from a chosen target point through each source fibre. The lift has the same finite length and cannot escape a complete source; extend it to the endpoint. This proves surjectivity and yields inverse branches over a sufficiently small normal ball. Uniqueness of lifted radial paths makes these branches disjoint and exhaustive, hence evenly covered. Lift geodesic extensions to transfer completeness to M. Sources: Datar §§20.1 and 24.3, pp.147–149, 178–179; Eschenburg §5, pp.17–19.
